extracted.name: Orange-Pineapple Ice
extracted.description: Combine condensed milk, crushed pineapple, and orange soda — pop it in the ice cream maker, and out comes a deliciously refreshing frozen dessert!
instruction_lines: Combine condensed milk, pineapple, and orange soda in the freezer canister of an ice cream maker. Freeze according to manufacturer’s directions.
